key_insight: The study developed an affordable water-based welding machine using seawater electrolysis principles and found it to be highly functional, acceptable, and promising for rural entrepreneurship.
engineering_relevance: This work shows how locally available materials and simple electrochemical principles can be turned into a practical fabrication technology for low-resource communities.
method: Used a Research and Development (R&D) approach with a descriptive-developmental design.
Built the machine through conceptualization, design, fabrication, testing, validation, and evaluation.
Assessed functionality, TAM-based acceptability, and entrepreneurial potential using a validated questionnaire.
evidence_signal: Evaluation from 138 respondents showed very high ratings for performance, efficiency, safety, durability, reliability, usefulness, ease of use, satisfaction, and intention to use, with ANOVA used for comparison.
watch_item: The abstract reports positive ratings but does not provide detailed experimental welding performance data or long-term field durability results, so real-world deployment should be validated further.
paper_title: INNOVATED WATER WELDING MACHINE FOR ENTREPRENEURSHIP
